profile.description:
Welcome to Delhi Equestrian Sports Academy – The Premier Horse Riding Academy in Delhi NCR!
 

📍 Location: [karala village , next to juglal farm]
📞 Contact:+ 91 99034 80646
💬 WhatsApp: +91 99034 80646
📧 Email: delhiequestrianclub@gmail.com
🌐 Website: www.delhiequestrianclub.in
🚀 Join us todaDELHI EQUESTRIAN SPORTS ACADEMY 
(DESA)-Karala[110081]



About the Coach 
Coach Sajjan Kumar is an elite International Show Jumping player and a former Honorary Captain of the President’s Bodyguard. With over 30 years of distinguished military service, he is a premier expert in training warm blood horses and horse schooling. ."

reasons.text: 频道简介自称是德里 NCR 的马术骑乘学院，介绍教练 Sajjan Kumar 的跳障与军事背景，主题为马术运动教学，不涉及马匹治疗或马辅助治疗。
唯一抽样视频标题提到“Captain Sajjan Kumar -Represented India in 14th Asian games”，内容指向竞技马术经历，与目标治疗主题无关。
